ideas.pitch: An autonomous security agent system that detects anomalous log patterns, conducts multi-agent forensic investigations, and isolates compromised endpoints without human intervention.
ideas.problem_statement: Track 1 — Agentic AI for Cybersecurity: Build an autonomous cybersecurity agent/system capable of detecting, analysing, investigating, and responding to security threats.
ideas.title: SentinelFlow: Autonomous Multi-Agent SIEM and Incident Response
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting Track 1 with a multi-agent orchestration workflow provides direct alignment with specialized security judges who value automated reasoning over simple rule-based alerts.

ideas.pitch: A healthcare agentic platform that ingests unstructured patient history, cross-references clinical guidelines, and automates discharge summary documentation and triage workflows.
ideas.problem_statement: Track 2 — Agentic AI for Healthcare: Build an Agentic AI solution that assists with healthcare-related decision support, information management, patient interaction, or workflow automation.
ideas.title: MediGraph AI: Autonomous Clinical Decision Support and Workflow Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles hospital administrative and clinical bottlenecks, which appeals to healthcare judges looking for measurable time-saving workflow automation.

ideas.pitch: An agentic NLP system that autonomously reads complex multilingual regulatory documents, extracts key compliance obligations, and performs cross-lingual legal reasoning.
ideas.problem_statement: Track 3 — Agentic AI for Natural Language Processing (NLP): Build an Agentic AI system that autonomously performs complex natural language understanding, information extraction, reasoning, generation, or multilingual NLP tasks.
ideas.title: LexiVerify: Multilingual Autonomous Legal and Policy Information Extraction
ideas.track: Track 3 — Agentic AI for Natural Language Processing (NLP)
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages advanced multilingual NLP capabilities and structured chain-of-thought verification, demonstrating technical depth beyond standard wrapper applications.

ideas.pitch: An open innovation agentic marketplace that monitors global shipping data, runs predictive risk simulations, and automatically negotiates alternative routing via API integrations.
ideas.problem_statement: Track 4 — Agentic AI for Open Innovation: Build an Agentic AI solution that addresses an open-ended real-world problem using autonomous reasoning, tool use, data, APIs, and/or multi-agent collaboration.
ideas.title: SupplyChainGuardian: Multi-Agent Risk Mitigation and Logistics Dispatch
ideas.track: Track 4 — Agentic AI for Open Innovation
ideas.why_it_could_win: Features active API tool use and multi-agent collaboration, creating a compelling live demo that solves a visible, high-stakes economic problem.

ideas.pitch: A real-time agentic voice assistant that intercepts suspicious communications, analyzes semantic intent for social engineering flags, and alerts vulnerable users before fraud occurs.
ideas.problem_statement: Track 3 — Agentic AI for Natural Language Processing (NLP): Build an Agentic AI system that autonomously performs complex natural language understanding, information extraction, reasoning, generation, or multilingual NLP tasks.
ideas.title: PhishShield Agent: Voice-First Senior Scam Detection and Prevention
ideas.track: Track 3 — Agentic AI for Natural Language Processing (NLP)
ideas.why_it_could_win: Employs a live voice-first interface which guarantees a memorable, high-impact demonstration for judges during the final evaluation.
